title: Reminder
description: A universal reminder/alarm envelope. It can point to any W3DS subject, not only a task. The timing model is compatible with iCalendar VALARM absolute triggers.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the vault holding the canonical reminder; present on reference copies

createdBy.description: eName of whoever set the reminder

recipientEName.description: eName of the person to be reminded

timezone.description: IANA zone the wall-clock time was meant in

action.description: What should happen when it fires

summary.description: Short line shown to the recipient

description.description: Longer text, when the summary is not enough

status.description: Where the reminder is in its life

snoozedUntil.description: New time the recipient pushed the reminder to

standard.description: External standard the timing follows, e.g. iCalendar VALARM

triggerKind.description: Whether the trigger is absolute or relative to the subject

remindAt.description: Absolute fire time — the legacy spelling of triggerAt. Readers prefer triggerAt when both are present.

message.description: Text shown when the reminder fires — the legacy spelling of summary
